context:
Goal: dashboard and comparison totals show in thousands, like every other amount (your 195 a).
Problem (rule): the report text on a dashboard card shows whole dollars, for example "A difference of $1,235 … $1,300 rounding allowance". That card's stat line and figures pane now show thousands, so one card mixes two units. D-632 (money shows in thousands) keeps report text in whole dollars, and q_max changes an entry only on your new ruling.
Based on (read): src/utils/reconcileReport.ts and materiality.ts build the report text; D-632's "Not changed" bullet covers text that an RFI or a stored report shows.
Departs from: main (report text on the card in whole dollars) — the on-screen report text shows thousands; RFI and export text stay in whole dollars.

Meanwhile: the lane fixes the review findings that do not depend on this, then waits for your answer before review round 2.

options.how: Show thousands in the on-screen report text, and state the unit once in its own words. Narrow D-632's "Not changed" bullet to RFI and export text.
options.label: Thousands in the on-screen report text
options.lose: About 10 report lines and their tests change; a stored report reads differently on screen than in an RFI.

options.gain: D-632 stays as it is; a smaller change.
options.how: Report text stays in whole dollars, and the card's headline goes back to whole dollars.
options.label: Keep whole dollars in the report text, undo the headline change
options.lose: The card shows the grand total twice, once in whole dollars and once in thousands.

reply: You answered on the page at 16:53 CST Nov 6: "pick whichever is built for now and leave the question open/deferred". Parked as deferred; home: q_max decision D-632 and the triage outbox list of parked items.
title: On a q_max dashboard card, should the reconcile report text also show thousands?
why: Recommended: a. One card shows one unit, which is what your 195 a asked for; RFI and export text keep exact dollars.
